abstract: Maintains atmospheric emission monitoring status and thermal oxidation abatement performance records
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance auditor (ENV). The Environmental compliance auditor (ENV) oversees atmospheric emission monitoring integrity and tracks thermal oxidation abatement performance records across solvent reclamation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-CM2：Fence-line surveillance monitors recorded a nighttime acoustic perimeter level of 55 dBA for Rhineland CleanPur Recovery Facility between 22:00 and 06:00 during May 2026.
ENV-NOISE-9RZ：According to continuous fence-line acoustic surveillance logs recorded between 22:00 and 06:00 during May 2026, Scheldt EcoSolv Complex exhibited a nighttime acoustic perimeter level of 48 dBA.
ENV-NOISE-270：Acoustic boundary surveillance logs during May 2026 recorded a nighttime acoustic perimeter level of 42 dBA for Kempen Petrochemical Recycling Center between 22:00 and 06:00.

information_points.title: Maintains atmospheric emission monitoring status and thermal oxidation abatement performance records（EMISS）
information_points.content:
ENV-EMISS-21W：Kempen Petrochemical Recycling Center maintains operational continuous emission monitoring on its main thermal oxidizer exhaust stack as confirmed by analyzer telemetry. Stack test certificates during full-load distillation verify a VOC destruction efficiency of 98 %.
ENV-EMISS-6UL：At Rhineland CleanPur Recovery Facility, continuous emission monitoring is enabled at the main thermal oxidizer exhaust stack according to stack analyzer telemetry logs. Stack test certification during full-load solvent distillation records a VOC destruction efficiency of 94 %.
ENV-EMISS-6HY：For Scheldt EcoSolv Complex, stack analyzer telemetry logs confirm that continuous emission monitoring is enabled on the main thermal oxidizer exhaust stack. Compliance stack testing during full-load solvent distillation demonstrates a VOC destruction efficiency of 99 %.
